records.object: Andrea di Bartolo, The Nativity of the Virgin
records.findingEn: NGA states this panel and 1939.1.41 and 1939.1.43 came from one Marian childhood altarpiece; original arrangement is scholarly reconstruction, other panels are lost, and center subject unknown. Link known surviving panels as related physical components, but do not invent a complete reconstructed altarpiece or duplicate artwork count.
records.findingFr: La NGA rattache ce panneau aux numéros 1939.1.41 et 1939.1.43 d'un même retable consacré à l'enfance de Marie. L'agencement originel demeure hypothétique et le sujet central est inconnu. Ne pas inventer de retable intégral ni dédoubler les œuvres.
records.rights: NGA object page explicitly public domain

records.object: Stefan Lochner, Martyrdom of Ss Simon and Judas
records.findingEn: Museum's indexed Iconclass specifies Simon the Zealot beheaded (73F3321) and Jude Thaddeus beaten and beheaded (73F324). This supports precise identification of the paired martyrdom scene, not an assertion of historically established death circumstances. The 10/12 parent-cycle relationship from B30 remains.
records.findingFr: L'indexation Iconclass du Städel distingue la décapitation de Simon (73F3321) et le martyre de Jude Thaddée, battu et décapité (73F324). Il s'agit d'une identification iconographique, non d'une preuve historique des circonstances du martyre.

records.object: Giovanni Battista Gaulli, La Prédication de saint Jean Baptiste
records.findingEn: Louvre confirms Gaulli attribution, oil on canvas, 182 x 172 cm, Denon room 717, and provenance: begun for Jesuits in Rome, acquired for Louis XIV in 1685. This authenticates the approved Advent IV physical painting. Catalogue access is not evidence of a freely reusable exact photograph; no image licence or museum download was validated in this pass.
records.findingFr: Le Louvre confirme l'attribution à Gaulli, la toile de 182 × 172 cm, l'exposition salle 717 et la provenance (commande jésuite à Rome, acquisition pour Louis XIV en 1685). L'accès à la notice ne constitue pas une autorisation de réutilisation de la photographie.
